steps.label: Check on Maria after a month away (Follower rank 7).
Enter the Varmareno Coliseum's Ranked League and win Bronze II.
Accompany Eupha to the church for Ovi's mother (Follower rank 4).
Join Junah at the Brilehaven tailor (Follower rank 4).
Answer Maria's summons at the inn (Follower rank 8).
Take the cooking lesson with Maria and Fabienne — follow each dish's cue.
Check on Ovi and the others with Eupha (Follower rank 5).
Keep Junah positive before the festival (Follower rank 5).
The lance must be in hand today — wrap up the Drakodios trail.
Warp to Martira and slay the human greatworm with Strohl's General buffs (Follower rank 7 for Bardon).
Dragon Festival: invite a companion to the flames and grant their wish for a unique weapon of their Archetype.
Depart for Altabury Heights.
Use the last Tail Bait on the deck's fishing rod before arrival.
At camp, start Eupha's 'How to Walk Outside the Island'.
Continue 'How to Walk Outside the Island' (Eupha's book).
Stop by Colerodio Cliff.
Reflect on the past with Eupha in the lounge.
Finish 'How to Walk Outside the Island'.
Tolerance reaches rank 5 (Saviour).
Pass the Murky Graveyard.
Collect all four Gold Beetles on the Lunlumo Approach and Blue Sky Bridge before sleeping at the inn.
Gold Beetle in the Skyward Tavern corner; take 'Village Trading: Altabury Heights' from the Informant.
Dia Franco Street shopping: Brocaded Koi from the Dedicated Butcher and the frayed goods for trading.
Before the Opera House, collect the Gold Beetle at the Charadrius pier.
Attend the Opera House — the production turns into a duel to the death.
See how the town reacts to the Opera House news, then rest.
Clear the Royal Academy Ruins — break Rella's Quartz Wall every turn and guard Sogne's fire.
Ten days remain before the duel in Grand Trad — talk with Loveless to mark his runner, then take 'Warmth in Winter' from the Portly Man.

guidanceSections.title: Altabury errands
guidanceSections.body: Loveless is outside the Skyward Tavern. Speak with the Portly Man for Warmth in Winter; Durable Spider Silk is obtained at the later Malva stop.

steps.label: Speak with Rudolf to mark his Gauntlet Runner, then take 'Proof of Power' from the Obsessive Soldier at Opera House Square.

guidanceSections.title: Runner and request
guidanceSections.body: Speak with Rudolf in the southeast, then visit the Obsessive Soldier near the Opera House Square stairs for Proof of Power.

steps.label: Give the Man in Pain a Medicinal Herb for Tainted Threads and a Tail Bait, then take the Icebeast Chimenzahn bounty 'The Fiend in the Frozen Forest' at the Recruitment Centre.

guidanceSections.title: Bridge and bounty
guidanceSections.body: The Man in Pain is near Whitepeaks Magic Shop on Blue Sky Bridge. After exchanging a Medicinal Herb, visit the Recruitment Centre for the Chimenzahn bounty.

steps.label: Help Eupha with Ovi and the others (Follower rank 6); receive 'Wayward Shepherd'.

guidanceSections.title: New request
guidanceSections.body: The Eupha visit leads to Wayward Shepherd. Accepting it here prepares the later Mt. Vulkano visit; this conversation alone does not finish that rescue.

steps.label: Meet Catherina at Lower Blue Sky Bridge (Follower rank 5).

guidanceSections.title: Night visit
guidanceSections.body: Catherina is near the magic shop on Lower Blue Sky Bridge. The Skyward Tavern informant also supplies the Giant of the Tower of Insolence lead.

steps.label: Cook Amber Stew, then set off for Malva — reaching this fifth town completes the route's Globetrotter town set.
Junah shows you something in the lounge (Follower rank 6).
Loveless boards the runner — an easy fight after the Opera House.
Accept 'Defeat Milo', return the Durable Spider Silk for 'Warmth in Winter', then speak with Milo near the Recruitment Centre.
Debate Julian at Upper Blue Sky Bridge (answer: the present day matters too).
Cook Enchanted Pottage with the flour from Malva, then hunt Milo's runner.
Basilio introduces himself in the Engine Room Corridor (Follower rank 1).
Milo's duel: mirror his Mage Mirror turns and burst him down.
Report Milo's defeat to Loveless, then help Catherina confront her worries (Follower rank 6).
Cook Adamantine Honey Cake, then run down Rudolf's runner.
Start the 'Literacy Workbook' Basilio added.
Rudolf's duel: his team is physical-focused — raise defense and counter.
Return to the Gauntlet Runner and accompany Junah (Follower rank 7).
Check on Basilio's shopping (Follower rank 2).
Meet Catherina at Lower Blue Sky Bridge (Follower rank 7).
Cook Cursed Love Ballad (or pack Hex cleansers) and fly to Mt. Vulkano for Eupha's request.

guidanceSections.title: Before departure
guidanceSections.body: Carry a way to remove Hex. Cursed Love Ballad is one option; appropriate cleansing items are another.

steps.label: Continue the 'Literacy Workbook'.
Imagination reaches rank 5 (Demiurgic).
Clear Mt. Vulkano: recover its lost relic and Gold Beetle, take the crawl-space ladder route to the Rusty Greatsword for the future 'The Edge of Glory' request, and rescue the believers for Eupha.

guidanceSections.title: Relic and beetle
guidanceSections.body: For the beetle, climb the ladder east of the Orehound and search between the first two holes. The relic chest is beyond the second hole along the right wall.

guidanceSections.title: Rusty Greatsword detour
guidanceSections.body: From B5, take the central route up to B4. Skip the first B3 ladder, find the crawl space and follow the other ladder chain to the first-floor chest. Avoid dropping through holes on this detour.

steps.label: Fly to Everfrost Forest; cook Indestructible Honey Cake (save one for a request).
All 20 recipes cooked — 'Sublime Spoonful' unlocks.
Chat with Basilio (Follower rank 3), then stop at Solstice Crossing.
Clear Everfrost Forest; recover its lost relic and Gold Beetle.
Report the Icebeast hunt at the Recruitment Centre.
Head for Scoundrel's Hold; train with Basilio on deck for bonus max HP.
When prompted, stop at Ligno and check its equipment shop before continuing the journey.
At camp, give Neuras one of the recovered lost relics (Follower rank 5).
Finish the 'Literacy Workbook'.
Clear Scoundrel's Hold — lost relic and Gold Beetle inside; the mobs are small fries.
Report the Scoundrel's Hold quest — last day for the inn cooking evenings.
Help Basilio look for Vinca (Follower rank 4).
Visit Myrtus with Junah (Follower rank 8).
Depart for the Royal Capital — the duel with Louis is now.
Gallica reaches Follower rank 7; talk with your allies before bed.
Browse the upgraded Sunshade Row stock and grab a Soothing Sweetbun.
Take the stage at Regalith Grand Cathedral — Louis at full power reads your turns, so play around his predictions.
In the Ancient Eldan Sanctum, collect the missable Gold Beetle east of the Plaza of Light before advancing into the one-way story sequence.

guidanceSections.title: Before the story marker
guidanceSections.body: At the Plaza of Light, go east behind the ruined house roof for the beetle. Collect it before following the northward mission marker into the one-way sequence.

steps.label: Gallica reaches Follower rank 8.
Return to Grand Trad; More's deciphered scrolls unlock the Royal Archetypes at Akademeia.
Hand over the Rusty Greatsword for 'The Edge of Glory' — thirty days remain until the crowning.
At the Recruitment Centre, take the three new bounties: 'The Incarnate in the Woods', 'The Cockatrice in the Clouds', and 'The Apostles of the Apocalypse'.
Turn in an Indestructible Honey Cake for 'The Queen of Cuisine: Soul'.
In Brilehaven, take 'Trial of the Dragon: Mad Mischief' from the Gabby Mustari at Angler's Inn Square.
In Eht Ria, take 'Trial of the Dragon: Heroes' Rest' from Edeni.
In Altabury Heights, take 'Trial of the Dragon: Bygone Legacy' from the Enraged Mustari and 'Deliver Hot Spring Water' from the Gentle Merchant.
Meet Basilio and Vinca (Follower rank 5), then answer Brigitta's summons at night (Follower rank 8).
Visit the recovered Bardon (Follower rank 8).
Hear Catherina's announcement to her paripus mates (Follower rank 8).
Convince Basilio to act and find Vinca together (Follower rank 6).
Show Neuras another lost relic (Follower rank 6); only 'A Dream's Origin' remains.
Rest at the Lycaon Magic Association bench.
Deliver the final lost relic to Neuras (Follower rank 7); 'Petty Thief' arrives to recover the stolen ones.
Depart for the Disgraced Ruins; cook the final recipe, Sublime Spoonful.
Plant seeds in the Plant Culture Chamber, then stop at Malibelo Slope.
Wisdom reaches rank 5 (Sagacious).
At the Disgraced Ruins, grab the Gold Beetle near the entrance and clear the bandit hideout.
After mastering an Elite Archetype, report to More (Follower rank 8).
